plain: A district of a city or county set up for voting or policing

webster.text: The limit, bound or exterior line encompassing a place; as the precincts of light.

example.quote: Provided notwithstanding, that the several towns, parishes, precincts, and other bodies-politic, or religious societies, shall, at all times, have the exclusive right of electing their public teachers, and of contracting with them for their support and maintenance.
